name: ORMQueryExecute
description: Modern alias to ORMExecuteQuery(). Run an HQL query on the default ORM datasource.
syntax: ORMQueryExecute( string hql, [any paramsOrUnique], [any uniqueOrQueryOptions], [any queryOptions] )

params.name: hql
params.description: The HQL query string to execute.

params.name: paramsOrUnique
params.description: Struct of named parameters, array of positional parameters, or boolean unique flag.

params.name: uniqueOrQueryOptions
params.description: Boolean unique flag (if params provided) or struct of query options.

params.name: queryOptions
params.description: Struct of query options: maxResults, offset, cacheable, cacheName, timeout, datasource.
